recipients_address_chk.name: recipients_address_chk
recipients_address_chk.value:
("notification_recipients"."channel"::text = 'WHATSAPP' and "notification_recipients"."phone_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' and "notification_recipients"."email" is null)
        or ("notification_recipients"."channel"::text = 'EMAIL' and "notification_recipients"."email" is not null and "notification_recipients"."phone_e164" is null)
